levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: «فقد رويته عن أبي؛ و محمد بن الحسن» — «و» joins the two co-transmitters into one level; «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation
«- رضي اللّه عنهما -» is removed; «و لقبه كرّام» is a laqab remark about the last link and is left out of the surface
«و ما كان فيه» points at a book the text does not name in this report; the chain as written runs to Abd al-Karim
